text: The two legacy criteria of RWB-E4-043 are kept word for word and are tested on a synthetic settlement set of this run: case RC-2026-000431 with settlement treatment TR-2026-000431 and receipt PR-2026-000431 of source CUSTOMER on the business date, matched to SETTLEMENT. The settlement detail behind the generic legacy lines is filled from FSD P8 A2.3 and TSD P8, and the legacy test case IDs keep their own rows in the Test Cases master.
why: The legacy criteria and their four test cases name no case, treatment, receipt, amount or date, and the FSD main success criterion is one line marked 'Written one epic ahead', so the story cannot be built or tested without a stated data set.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-043 (Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Test cases); FSD P8 v3 A2.3.4.1; work package line for RWB-P8-E4043-APP
confirm: P8 business analyst and the Settlement route set owner at the E4 test data review
impact: The test data and the traceability row only; both criteria, their wording and the four test case IDs are unchanged

text: The settlement arm runs inside the JOB-07 event-started workflow on queue rwb-payment, started by AceDataReady of source ALS, and evaluates the PAYMENT_MATCH package at the version in force; the tolerance, the window, the grace and the partial floor are values of the package and never of the build; the money-side answer carries the rule ID and the package version, and the outcome code and the case move stay with the parent CaseWorkflow of rwb-case.
why: No source gives the package code, the rule IDs, the threshold values, the outcome fields or the case move of the settlement match, and the step cannot be evaluated or asserted without a stated reading.
read: FSD P8 v3 A2.3.2, A2.3.3.1 and A2.3.4.4; TSD P8 v2 T3.1 and T3.2; context pack P8 (EV-12, JOB-07) and the Temporal and Drools slide 14 pattern
confirm: P7 rule owner and the P8 solution architect at the rule package review
impact: The package, the trigger and the answer only; the criteria, the messages, the lists and the 2 s budget are unchanged

text: rwb-payment holds no grant on the recovery.v_ace_* views and no grant on another rwb_* schema, so the receipt facts and the ACE batch status are read on the rwb-source-data contract with its freshness stamp; the legacy v_ace_payment and v_ace_batch_status reads are retired, and VR-P8-003-1 with MSG-P1-001 is kept exactly as the FSD states it.
why: The legacy story reads two ACE views in process while the target gives SELECT on the views to rwb-source-data alone, and the story cannot be built against a grant it will not have.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-043 (Data); FSD P8 v3 change note and A2.3.3.1; context pack P8; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-05
confirm: P1 source-data owner and the P8 solution architect at the contract review
impact: One read path and one grant only; the stale-data rule, its message and every criterion are unchanged

text: The metadata row 'Contract dependencies' stays None as the work package gives it, and the four consumed reads of section 12.2 are treated as class C dependencies built against their published documents and fakes from Day 1: the rwb-source-data receipt read, the rwb-case case read and money-side answer, the rwb-treatment treatment read and the rwb-decision package read.
why: The work package gives C as empty while the step consumes four contracts, and R5.4 makes a class C row non-blocking, so the two statements have to be read together rather than one corrected silently.
read: Work package line for RWB-P8-E4043-APP; Template and Rules R5.4 and R5.7; section 12.2 of the story
confirm: P8 solution architect and the split-plan owner at the next plan version
impact: The dependency display only; Day 1, the lane, the H rows and every criterion are unchanged

text: The MatchRequest element carries the case reference, the treatment reference, the account payment reference, the amount, the received date and the match value, and the ProceedsPage element carries the page of Proceeds with page, size and total; every field that no source gives is marked with the placeholder until the API Specification of rwb-payment publishes it.
why: The TSD names the two elements without a field list, and the contract baseline cannot publish a body or an answer without a field set.
read: TSD P8 v2 T-A.1 and T-A.2; TSD P8 v2 T3.1 and T3.2; legacy RWB-E4-043 (Endpoints)
confirm: P8 solution architect and the API specification owner at the baseline review
impact: Two element shapes only; the paths, the rights, the error sets and the lists are unchanged

text: The three event schemas are written from the CloudEvents 1.0 binary envelope with key caseId, the published PaymentMissed example (caseId, treatmentId, dueDate, amountDue, daysLate) and the modelled columns of proceeds and treatment; the fields of TreatmentBooked and ProceedsMatched that no source gives carry the placeholder, and the registry stays in BACKWARD mode so the owner can settle them without a breaking change.
why: Two of the three payloads are unpublished, and the baseline has to register something the five consumers can pin.
read: Architecture v5 slides 42 and 43 (EV-11, EV-12, EV-25); TSD P8 v2 T5.3; context pack P8 events
confirm: P8 solution architect and the event catalogue owner at the next catalogue version
impact: Two schema field lists only; the event names, the topic, the key and the no-PII rule are unchanged

text: The contract names R-SET-14 (AWAITING_PAYMENT to PAYMENT_CLEARED, amount_received = settlement_amount) as the settlement money-side transition and the PAYMENT_MATCH package of the Temporal and Drools design as the rule set, and it fixes no package code and no rule ID; payment_match_rule is not declared as a table of rwb_payment because the package replaces it in rwb-decision.
why: The rule that matches and posts the settlement payment has a name in the routing logic, the package code and the mechanism's rule IDs do not, and the TSD still models the replaced table.
read: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-SET-14); TSD P8 v2 T3.1; Temporal and Drools design; context pack P8 ownership rows
confirm: P7 rule owner and the P8 solution architect at the rule registry review
impact: One rule name and one retired table only; the vocabulary, the criteria and the events are unchanged

text: Both stories are issued in status Draft (realignment v1), the release date 28 February 2027 is copied unchanged and marked tentative, and the PRD reference stays Pending (C1), because no human approval gate was met in this run and none is required under D-RCV-60.
why: The realignment run proceeds without human approval and no approved BRD, PRD or status is available to cite, so the default status has to be stated rather than left empty.
